device_name.description: For a browser or CLI Session, the name the client reported at sign-in or the User later chose. A Desktop Session's name is desktop_registration_display_name.

expires_at.description: When the Session ends no matter how often it is used.

idle_expires_at.description: When the Session ends if it stays unused. Each recorded use of the Session moves this later.

last_activity_at.description: When the Session was last used. Proctor records use at most once per activity update interval, so this can trail the latest request.

mfa_completed_at.description: When the Session last passed two-step verification. Left out when it never has.

mfa_enrollment_required.description: Whether the Access Policy limits this Web Session until its User sets up or completes two-step verification. While it is true, the Session can only set up two-step verification, answer the two-step verification challenge, reauthenticate, read the security status and sign out.

mfa_recovery_required.description: Whether the Session can't be used normally until the User sets up a new authenticator app for two-step verification.

reauthenticated_at.description: When the User last proved who they are again on this Session, with the same method they signed in with. It does not change authenticated_at or mfa_completed_at. Left out when the Session has never reauthenticated.

revocation_reason.description: A readable explanation of revocation_reason_code in the request's language. Present only when the Session was revoked.

revocation_reason_code.description: Why the Session was revoked. Present only when revoked_at is set.

revoked_at.description: When the Session was revoked. Left out while it is still active.

updated_at.description: When the Session record last changed.

user_id.description: The ID of the User the Session belongs to.

DeliveryBudgetSnapshot.description: Delivery usage of one Participation and of its Attempt.

browser_evidence_bytes.description: Total size in bytes of the browser Integrity Evidence kept for the Attempt. At most 8 MiB.

browser_evidence_records.description: Number of browser Integrity Evidence records kept for the Attempt. At most 10,000.

browser_flag_groups.description: Number of browser Integrity Flag groups recorded for the Attempt. At most 256.

control_metadata_bytes.description: Bytes of delivery control metadata recorded for the Attempt, such as declarations and receipts. At most 2 MiB.

explicit_missing_intervals.description: Number of declared missing ranges recorded for the Attempt. At most 4,096.

server_time.description: Server time when the snapshot was taken.

DeliveryClosure.description: Delivery closure. An open delivery carries only unknown_tail false; a closed one carries closed_at, close_reason, known_at_close and upload_expires_at, plus the final sequence, declaration and boundary origin when they are known. Absent members are omitted, never null.

DeliveryFamilyBudget.description: Delivery usage for one family, native or browser.

attempt.description: Lifetime usage of the Attempt across every Participation Generation.

participation.description: Usage of the current Participation Generation.

pending_byte_limit.description: Most bytes that may wait to be processed. Always 2 MiB.

pending_bytes.description: Bytes of records the server has received but not yet processed, for example because earlier positions are still missing.

DeliveryQuotaUsage.description: Usage and limits for one delivery family, for either the current Participation or the whole Attempt.

allocated_positions.description: Number of sequence positions reserved so far.

byte_limit.description: Most bytes of records the server will keep.

position_limit.description: Most sequence positions that can be reserved.

record_limit.description: Most records the server will keep.

retained_bytes.description: Total size in bytes of the records the server has kept so far.

retained_records.description: Number of records the server has kept so far.

stop_reason.description: Why detailed delivery stopped. records, bytes, positions and metadata name the limit that was reached. local_loss_inventory_exhausted means the client stopped it. Null while detailed delivery continues.

summary_only.description: True once detailed delivery has stopped. After that the server keeps only summary counts, and the counters no longer change.

DeliveryRecovery.description: Current delivery progress and budget, sent with a refused delivery so the client can recover. It is at most 32 KiB. It does not mean the server accepted any of the refused data, and progress read at different moments may differ while other uploads run. Left out when the server can't confirm you still own the delivery, or the delivery has ended. Sent with `pending_capacity`, `replay_window_exceeded`, `detail_budget_exhausted`, `sequence_limit`, `declaration_conflict`, `upload_expired` and the delivery rate-limit errors.

browser_status.description: Current status of the browser source. Present only when `family` is `browser`.

family.description: Which delivery the data belongs to, `native` security data or `browser` activity.

native_status.description: Current status of the native security stream. Present only when `family` is `native`.

display_name.description: The account's display name.

email.description: The authenticated account's own email address, shown so the person can confirm which account the Desktop will use.

id.description: The ID of the account the browser signed in as.

expires_at.description: When the one-time code expires. It lasts at most one minute.

redirect_url.description: The Desktop's loopback callback address with the one-time code and state added as query parameters. Send the browser there to hand the code to the Desktop.

DesktopAuthorizationCompatibilityRespons.description: The versions of the Proctor Desktop browser authorization protocol this server accepts.

maximum_version.description: The newest protocol version the server accepts.

minimum_version.description: The oldest protocol version the server accepts.

account.description: The account that signed in for this request. Present only when state is authenticated.

device_name.description: The device name the Desktop sent when it started, shown so the person can recognize the request. Empty when the Desktop sent none.

expires_at.description: When this authorization request expires.

external_providers.description: The external sign-in providers the page may offer.

local_login_enabled.description: Whether the page may offer username and password sign-in.

requested_at.description: When Proctor Desktop started this authorization request.

state.description: Where the request stands. bound means this browser holds the request but no account is signed in for it yet. second_factor_required means the provider proved the account and Proctor still needs its code. authenticated means an account is signed in and the request is waiting for approval.

architecture.description: The processor architecture the Desktop was built for. It must match the value sent when the authorization started.

code.description: The one-time code from the code query parameter Proctor added to the loopback callback address.

code_verifier.description: The PKCE verifier whose S256 hash the Desktop sent as code_challenge.

desktop_build_id.description: The Desktop build identifier. It must match the value sent when the authorization started.

desktop_release.description: The Desktop release version. It must match the value sent when the authorization started.

platform.description: The operating system the Desktop runs on. It must match the value sent when the authorization started.

public_jwk.description: The same public key the Desktop sent when it started. The DPoP proof header must be signed with its private key.

realtime_protocol.description: The realtime protocol version the Desktop speaks. It must match the value sent when the authorization started.

state.description: The state value the Desktop sent when it started. It must also match the state on the loopback callback.

login_id.description: The username or email address of the local account. Case and surrounding spaces are ignored.

mfa_code.description: A current six-digit authenticator code or one unused recovery code. Needed when the account uses two-step verification. Without it, the attempt fails with authentication.mfa.required.

password.description: The account's local password. Treat it as a secret and keep it out of traces and logs.

browser_proof.description: The one-time browser proof from the proof value in the authorization page address fragment.

handle.description: The one-time request handle from the request query parameter of the authorization page address.

state.description: The state value from the authorization page address. It must match the state the Desktop sent when it started.

architecture.description: The processor architecture the Desktop was built for.

callback_url.description: The Desktop's loopback callback address. It must use http, the host 127.0.0.1 or [::1], a port from 49152 through 65535, and a path made of one random token of 43 URL-safe base64 characters. A query, fragment or user name is not allowed. Leading zeroes in a valid port are kept as sent.

code_challenge.description: The PKCE S256 challenge: the URL-safe base64 SHA-256 hash of the code_verifier the Desktop will send to the token exchange, without padding.

desktop_build_id.description: The identifier of the exact Desktop build. Proctor checks it against the Desktop compatibility policy.

desktop_release.description: The Desktop release version, such as 1.4.0. Proctor checks it against the Desktop compatibility policy.

device_id.description: An identifier the Desktop chooses for its device, up to 128 bytes. It is recorded on the new Session.

device_name.description: A readable device name, up to 128 characters. The hosted page shows it so the person can recognize the request, and Session management shows it later.

platform.description: The operating system the Desktop runs on.

public_jwk.description: The public half of the P-256 key the Desktop will sign its DPoP proofs with. The token exchange must send the same key.

realtime_protocol.description: The realtime protocol version the Desktop speaks. Proctor checks it against the Desktop compatibility policy.

state.description: A random value the Desktop makes for this sign-in: 32 random bytes as 43 URL-safe base64 characters. The hosted page and the code exchange must send the same value back.

authorization_url.description: The hosted authorization page to open in the system browser. Its query carries the request handle and state, and its fragment carries the one-time browser proof.

expires_at.description: When this authorization request expires. It lasts at most five minutes.

state.description: The state value the Desktop sent when it started this authorization.

administrator_message.description: Plain text, up to 500 characters, that the server sends to Proctor Desktop with its compatibility status. Leading and trailing spaces are removed, and control characters are rejected. Send an empty string for no message.

availability.description: `ready` lets Proctor Desktop sign in and start Attempts. `maintenance` refuses Desktop sign-in and Attempt entry until you set it back to `ready`.

expected_revision.description: The `revision` of the policy you based this replacement on. If the policy has changed since, the request fails with `desktop_compatibility_policy.revision_conflict`.

minimum_desktop_release.description: The oldest Proctor Desktop release the Institution accepts, written as a plain semantic version such as `1.4.0`, with no leading `v`. Older releases are refused. Send an empty string for no Institution minimum.

retry_at.description: Optional. When Proctor Desktop should try again during maintenance. Leave it out for no retry time, and always leave it out while `availability` is `ready`. Null is rejected.

revoked_desktop_build_ids.description: Desktop build IDs to refuse even though this server release lists them as verified. Send an empty list to revoke none.

administrator_message.description: Plain text the server sends to Proctor Desktop with its compatibility status. Empty when there is no message.

availability.description: `ready` while Proctor Desktop may sign in and start Attempts. `maintenance` while Desktop sign-in and Attempt entry are refused.

minimum_desktop_release.description: The oldest Proctor Desktop release the Institution accepts. Empty when the Institution sets no minimum.

retry_at.description: When Proctor Desktop should try again. Present only during maintenance when a retry time is set.

revision.description: Goes up with every change. Send it as `expected_revision` when you replace the policy.

revoked_desktop_build_ids.description: Desktop build IDs refused even though this server release lists them as verified.

updated_at.description: When the policy last changed.

x.description: The key's x coordinate, as 43 URL-safe base64 characters.

y.description: The key's y coordinate, as 43 URL-safe base64 characters.

code.description: The one-time code from the code query parameter Proctor added to the loopback callback address.

code_verifier.description: The PKCE verifier whose S256 hash the Desktop sent as code_challenge.

state.description: The state value the Desktop sent when it started this reauthentication.

authentication_strength.description: The strength of the Desktop Session after confirming the account.

recently_authenticated_until.description: Until this time, actions that need a recent sign-in are allowed. After it, they ask for reauthentication again.

authentication_method.description: The one sign-in method this reauthentication accepts. It is always the method the Desktop Session itself used.

display_name.description: The Desktop Session account's display name, so the person can see whose sign-in they are confirming.

expires_at.description: When this reauthentication request expires. It lasts at most five minutes.

provider.description: The Desktop Session's own identity provider. Present only when authentication_method is external.

state.description: Where the reauthentication stands. bound means this browser holds the request but has not proved the account yet. second_factor_required means the primary proof succeeded and a code is needed. authenticated means the proof succeeded and the request is waiting for approval.

password.description: The local password of the Desktop Session's account. Treat it as a secret and keep it out of traces and logs.

callback_url.description: The Desktop's loopback callback address, checked by the same rules as Desktop authorization. It must use http, the host 127.0.0.1 or [::1], a port from 49152 through 65535, and a path made of one random token of 43 URL-safe base64 characters.

code_challenge.description: The PKCE S256 challenge: the URL-safe base64 SHA-256 hash of the code_verifier the Desktop will send to the complete call, without padding.

state.description: A random value the Desktop makes for this reauthentication: 32 random bytes as 43 URL-safe base64 characters. The hosted page and the complete call must send the same value back.

DesktopRegistrationListResponse.description: One page of the collection in its stable order.

items.description: The registrations on this page, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Pass this back as cursor to get the next page. Left out on the last page.

architecture.description: The processor architecture the Desktop was built for, from the latest sign-in.

created_at.description: When the Desktop was first registered.

current.description: Whether the request was made by a Desktop Session bound to this registration.

desktop_build_id.description: The Desktop build identifier from the latest sign-in.

desktop_release.description: The Desktop release version from the latest sign-in.

display_name.description: The name shown for this Desktop. It is the name the User chose, or else the device name the Desktop last reported.

last_used_at.description: When a Desktop sign-in last used this registration.

platform.description: The operating system the Desktop runs on, from the latest sign-in.

realtime_protocol.description: The realtime protocol version the Desktop reported at the latest sign-in.

status.description: active while the registration can sign in, or revoked once it has been revoked for good.

DisableUserRequest.description: Optional details for disabling a User.

reason.description: Why the account is disabled. Leading and trailing spaces are removed. It can be up to 500 characters, with no control characters, and can't be only spaces. An empty string means no reason. It is kept only in the audit record, where Institution-wide audit readers see it on the disable event.

expected_revision.description: The Draft revision you last saw. If the Draft has changed since, the request fails with a conflict.

instructions_markdown.description: The new instructions, as Markdown. Up to 65,536 bytes of UTF-8. An empty string removes the instructions. Leave it out or send null to keep the current instructions.

title.description: The new title, up to 200 characters. Leading and trailing spaces are removed, and the result must not be empty. Leave it out or send null to keep the current title.

description_markdown.description: The new description, as Markdown. Up to 16,384 bytes of UTF-8. Leave it out or send null to keep the current description.

display_name.description: The new name, up to 255 characters. Leading and trailing spaces are removed. Leave it out or send null to keep the current name.

expected_revision.description: The Draft revision you last saw. If the Draft has changed since, the request fails with a conflict.

EffectiveExamSecurityPolicy.description: Frozen native semantics for a Participation. issued_at and active_from use millisecond UTC precision, with issued_at <= active_from <= activation time. There is no policy expiry; the renewable Participation lease is the sole live authority. The digest excludes only digest; scope rebinding preserves the separately computed content digest.

activations.description: The capabilities Desktop runs for this policy, with the sub-categories each selects.

capabilities.description: Exactly one family in this order: process_application, interactive_session, clipboard, printing, removable_storage, virtualization, network_configuration, camera, microphone, external_capture.

allowed_application_ids.description: The only catalog applications the candidate may run, sorted and unique: IDs from the Desktop release's application catalog, each one it marks allowable. Empty adds no allowlist. When the family is on, the catalog's never-allowable applications are always blocked.

outcome.description: What an enforce occurrence of this family leads to; flag unless mode is enforce.
What an enforce occurrence of this family leads to; flag unless mode is enforce.
What an enforce occurrence of this family leads to; flag unless mode is enforce.
What an enforce occurrence of this family leads to; flag unless mode is enforce.
What an enforce occurrence of this family leads to; flag unless mode is enforce.
What an enforce occurrence of this family leads to; flag unless mode is enforce.
What an enforce occurrence of this family leads to; flag unless mode is enforce.
What an enforce occurrence of this family leads to; flag unless mode is enforce.
What an enforce occurrence of this family leads to; flag unless mode is enforce.
What an enforce occurrence of this family leads to; flag unless mode is enforce.

rules.description: The compiled native rules: the release's baseline, unchanged, then the rules compiled from the Exam's family selections. Desktop evaluates them on the device; the server evaluates them again on the same facts.

masked_current_email.description: The account's current address, masked as in the email-change warning (first character, up to three asterisks, and the domain).

restored_email.description: The previous address the undo would restore. The token was emailed to this address.

token.description: The undo token from the link emailed to the previous address, as 43 URL-safe base64 characters.
The verification token from the link in the verification email, as 43 URL-safe base64 characters.

email.description: The address the token was issued for and would mark verified.

EndExamAttemptByManagerRequest.description: The Attempt revision you last read and a private reason for ending it.

expected_revision.description: The Attempt's current revision, as last read. The request fails with a conflict if the Attempt has changed since.

reason.description: Why you are ending the Attempt. It is kept for audit and is never shown to the candidate. Send valid UTF-8 with no leading or trailing whitespace: at most 1000 characters and 4000 bytes.

end_at.description: When the enrollment ends; it must be after the start. Omit it for no end.

start_at.description: When the enrollment starts. Omit it to start now.

password.description: The local password to add. It must meet the password rules and must not contain the username, the part of the email address before the @, or the person's name.

EnvironmentProfileListResponse.description: One page of the collection in its stable order.

cpu_millis.description: CPU time per second; 1000 is one full CPU.

idle_window_seconds.description: How long an environment may stay frozen before it is suspended to disk.

image.description: The execution image the hosts offer, by name.

max_terminals.description: The most terminals one Attempt may open.

network.description: `none` gives the environment no network; `allowlist` gives it only the execution host's configured allowlist.

retired_at.description: Present once the profile is retired.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error code. Later versions may add values. Show your own label for each value, and a general message for one you don't recognize.

close_reason.description: Why the Connection closed. Present only when state is closed.

closed_at.description: When the Connection closed. Present only when state is closed.

state.description: Whether the Connection is open or closed.

items.description: Attempts on this page, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omitted on the last page. Send it back unchanged as cursor.

ExamAttemptManagerResponse.description: An Exam Attempt, as a manager may see it.

active_suspension.description: The active Suspension. Omitted unless the Attempt is suspended.

admission_revision_id.description: ID of the Exam Revision the Attempt was admitted with.

current_connection.description: The open Connection. Omitted when no Connection is open.

latest_participation.description: The most recent Participation. Omitted when the candidate has never entered.

revision.description: Revision of the Attempt. It goes up with every change. Send it as expected_revision when you suspend or re-allow the Attempt.

state.description: Current state of the Attempt.

submitted_at.description: When the Attempt was submitted. Present only when state is submitted.

updated_at.description: When the Attempt last changed.

end_reason.description: Why the Participation ended. Present only when state is ended.

ended_at.description: When the Participation ended. Present only when state is ended.

generation.description: Participation Generation. Each new entry into the Attempt gets the next number.

lease_expires_at.description: When the Participation Lease runs out, or ran out.

renewal_sequence.description: Sequence number of the latest lease renewal. It only goes up.

state.description: Whether the Participation is active or has ended.

updated_at.description: When the Participation last changed, such as at its latest renewal.

candidate_reason.description: The reason the candidate was shown for the Suspension.

reallowed_by_user_id.description: ID of the User who re-allowed the Attempt.

state.description: State of the Attempt after the re-allow.

suspension_id.description: ID of the Suspension that was closed.

suspension_state.description: State of the Suspension. Always closed.

ExamAttemptState.description: Lifecycle state of an Exam Attempt. ready means the candidate may enter. active means a Participation is in progress. suspended means a Suspension blocks the Attempt. submitted means the Attempt has a Submission and is finished.

ExamAttemptSuspendResponse.description: The result of a manual suspension.

candidate_reason.description: The reason the candidate is shown. Always manager_suspended.

connection_closed.description: True when the suspension closed the candidate's open Connection.

state.description: State of the Attempt. Always suspended.

suspended_by_user_id.description: ID of the Exam Manager who suspended the Attempt.

suspension_id.description: ID of the new Suspension. Send it as suspension_id to re-allow the Attempt.

suspension_state.description: State of the Suspension. Always active.

ExamAttemptSuspensionResponse.description: One Suspension. A policy Suspension links its Integrity Flag in integrity_flag_id. A manual Suspension, when an Exam Manager kicks the candidate, links no Flag and names the manager in suspended_by_user_id.

candidate_reason.description: The reason the candidate is shown.

ended_at.description: When the Suspension was closed. Omitted while it is active.

generation.description: Participation Generation that was active when the Suspension started.

id.description: ID of the Suspension. Send it as suspension_id to re-allow the Attempt.

integrity_flag_id.description: ID of the Integrity Flag that caused a policy Suspension. Omitted for a manual Suspension.

participation_id.description: ID of the Participation that was active when the Suspension started.

reallowed_by_user_id.description: ID of the User who re-allowed the Attempt. Omitted while the Suspension is active.

source.description: policy when a rule suspended the Attempt automatically. manual when an Exam Manager did.

state.description: Whether the Suspension is still active or has been closed by a re-allow.

suspended_by_user_id.description: ID of the Exam Manager who suspended the Attempt. Present only for a manual Suspension.

cursor.description: Current Workspace Cursor. It goes up by one with every accepted change.

updated_at.description: When the Workspace last changed.

ExamCapacityPolicy.description: Size limits for Exam content and candidate Workspaces across the Institution. Publishing an Exam Revision keeps the limits in force at that moment, so later changes do not affect a Sitting already under way.

resource_maximum_bytes.description: Largest size of one Exam Resource, in bytes. The default is 10 MiB.

resource_maximum_count.description: Most Exam Resources one Exam can have. The default is 10.

workspace_maximum_entries.description: Most files and folders one Workspace can hold. The default is 500.

workspace_maximum_file_bytes.description: Largest size of one Workspace file, in bytes. The default is 10 MiB.

workspace_maximum_total_bytes.description: Largest total size of all files in one Workspace, in bytes. The default is 50 MiB.

ExamDraftResponse.description: The Exam's single editable Draft. Publishing copies it into a new Revision. Editing it afterwards never changes a Revision that is already published.

base_revision_id.description: The Revision most recently published from this Draft. Omitted until the Draft is first published.

browser_policy.description: Which websites candidates may open in the Exam browser during an Attempt.

capacity.description: The limits on Resources and Starter Workspace size that apply to this Draft.

exam_id.description: The Exam this Draft belongs to.

has_starter_workspace.description: True when the Draft's Starter Workspace has at least one file or directory.

instructions_markdown.description: The instructions shown to candidates, as Markdown. Up to 65,536 bytes of UTF-8. Empty when there are none.

resource_count.description: How many Resources the Draft has.

revision.description: The Draft's current revision number, starting at 1. It goes up with every Draft change, including Resource and Starter Workspace changes. Send it as expected_revision with your next Draft change.

title.description: The Exam title shown to candidates and staff.

updated_at.description: When the Draft last changed.

ExamExportResponse.description: A request for a temporary export archive, and its state.

archive_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the finished ZIP, in lowercase hexadecimal. It matches the `ETag` of the download. Present only while the export is ready.

archive_size_bytes.description: Size of the finished ZIP, in bytes. Present only while the export is ready.

categories.description: What to export: work, integrity, or both, or Browser Activity on its own. Browser Activity needs current Exam Manager status on this exact Exam and the dedicated history permission. Other exports never contain browsing URLs.

construction_deadline.description: Latest time the archive can finish building. It is at most 24 hours after the request and never after `expires_at`.

created_at.description: Time the export was requested. The expiry counts from this time.

exam_id.description: Exam the exported records belong to.

exam_sitting_id.description: Sitting the exported records belong to.

expires_at.description: Time after which the archive can't be downloaded. It is fixed when the export is requested.

file_count.description: Number of workspace entries in the export.

policy_revision.description: Retention policy revision whose export lifetime set the expiry.

ready_at.description: Time the archive became ready. Omitted unless the export is ready.

source_bytes.description: Total size, in bytes, of the original files being exported.

state.description: `queued` while the archive is being built, `ready` when it can be downloaded, `failed` if building failed, and `expired` after `expires_at`.

submission_count.description: Number of Submissions in the export.

submission_id.description: Submission that was exported. Present only for a Submission export.

ExamIdentityResponse.description: The Exam record itself, without its Draft content. Its revision changes when the Exam is published, archived, or its Managers or owner change.

academic_unit_id.description: The Academic Unit that owns the Exam.

archived_at.description: When the Exam was archived. Omitted while the Exam is active.

creator_user_id.description: The User who created the Exam. This never changes.

default_revision_id.description: The most recently published Revision of this Exam. Omitted until the Exam is first published.

owner_user_id.description: The User who currently owns the Exam. It starts as the creator and changes only by an ownership transfer.

revision.description: The Exam's current revision number, starting at 1. Send it as expected_revision when you archive the Exam or change its Managers or owner.

updated_at.description: When the Exam record last changed.

ExamIntegrityDiscrepancyListResponse.description: One page of Discrepancies for a Submission.

items.description: The Discrepancies on this page, at most `limit`.

next_cursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Omitted on the last page. Don't parse or build it yourself.

ExamIntegrityDiscrepancyResponse.description: One uncertainty about a sealed Submission's integrity data, visible only to managers. Members that belong to one `kind` appear only for that kind. A Discrepancy is not evidence, a finding of misconduct, a score or a grade.

browser_activity_source_session_id.description: The browser session with missing activity. Only for `browser_activity_gap`.

correction_revision_id.description: The correction that was never acknowledged. Only for `correction_acknowledgement_missing`.

duration_milliseconds.description: How long focus was lost, in milliseconds. Only for `late_focus_loss`.

exam_attempt_id.description: The Attempt the record belongs to.

final_sequence.description: The last sequence number the browser session declared, when it declared one. Only for `browser_activity_gap`.

focus_loss_signal_id.description: The late focus-loss signal. Only for `late_focus_loss`.

gap_reason.description: Why data is missing. The first three values apply to `focus_loss_gap`; the others apply to `browser_activity_gap`.

kind.description: `late_focus_loss` is a focus-loss signal that arrived after collection ended. `focus_loss_gap` and `browser_activity_gap` mean focus-loss or browser activity data is missing. `correction_acknowledgement_missing` means a required correction was never acknowledged.

missing_before.description: How many earlier sequence numbers were missing when this late signal arrived. Only for `late_focus_loss`.

participation_id.description: The Participation the record came from.

received_at.description: When the server recorded the Discrepancy.

sequence.description: The signal's sequence number. Only for `late_focus_loss`.

source.description: What the client reported as the cause of the focus loss. Only for `late_focus_loss`, when reported.

unresolved_count.description: How many unresolved items this Discrepancy stands for. Present for every kind except `late_focus_loss`; always 1 for `correction_acknowledgement_missing`.

ExamIntegrityEvidenceListResponse.description: One page of evidence records for a Flag.

items.description: The evidence records on this page, at most `limit`.

next_cursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Omitted on the last page. Don't parse or build it yourself.

ExamIntegrityEvidenceResponse.description: One evidence record kept for an integrity Flag. `signal_id` and `source` appear only for `focus_loss`, and `browser` only for `browser_navigation`. The numeric signal members are 0 for kinds they do not apply to.

detail.description: A capability's own evidence, one JSON object of at most 64 KiB that the server stores as given and does not interpret. Present only for capability and native kinds.

duration_milliseconds.description: How long focus was lost, in milliseconds. 0 for other kinds.

exam_attempt_id.description: The Attempt the evidence belongs to.

missing_before.description: How many earlier sequence numbers were missing when this signal arrived. 0 for other kinds.

observed_at.description: When the server received the signal. For `connection_loss`, when the connection's lease expired.

participation_id.description: The Participation the evidence came from.

sequence.description: The focus-loss signal's sequence number. 0 for other kinds.

next_cursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Omitted on the last page. Don't parse or build it yourself.

browser.description: The browser rule the Flag groups. Present only for `browser_navigation` Flags.

evidence_count.description: The number of evidence records kept for the Flag, at most 100.

evidence_overflow_count.description: The number of further evidence records observed but not kept because the limit was reached.

exam_attempt_id.description: The Attempt the Flag was raised on.

generation.description: The Participation generation the Flag was raised in.

policy_kind.description: The policy that raised the flag: a core policy (connection_loss, focus_loss or browser_navigation) or a capability's "<plugin-id>.<kind>". Treat an unknown kind as opaque.

state.description: Whether the Flag is open or closed.

unresolved_missing_count.description: The number of missing signals in the sequence that were still missing when collection ended.

ExamIntegrityReviewDecisionResponse.description: The current private decision on one integrity Flag.

actor_user_id.description: The manager who made the current decision.

decided_at.description: When the current decision was made.

integrity_flag_id.description: The Flag the decision is about.

inventory_stale.description: True when new evidence was accepted after this decision. Save a new decision on the Flag before finalizing.

outcome.description: The manager's conclusion about the Flag. It is never a grade or a verdict of guilt.

private_rationale.description: The manager's reason for the outcome. Only managers can see it.

candidate_user_id.description: The candidate who made the Submission.

decision.description: The saved decision. Present only when the request saved a decision.

browser_evidence_overflow.description: Browser events not kept as evidence because of the group limit. Omitted when none were dropped.

candidate_user_id.description: The candidate who made the Submission.

decisions.description: The current decision for each Flag that has one. Empty until a decision is saved.

native_conditions.description: The count and digest of native condition records kept for the Attempt.

review.description: The Review. Omitted until a manager creates one.

unresolved_integrity_count.description: The number of unresolved integrity items. While above 0, they can block finalization.

manager.description: The Manager the change was about.

next_cursor.description: Send this back as cursor to get the next page. Omitted on the last page.

ExamManagerResponse.description: One User who manages the Exam, and where that responsibility came from.

granted_at.description: When this User became a Manager.

granted_by_user_id.description: The User who made this person a Manager. For the creator, this is the creator.

is_creator.description: True when this User created the Exam. This never changes, even after an ownership transfer.

is_owner.description: True when this User currently owns the Exam. In the response to a removal, it is always false, because the User no longer manages the Exam.

user_id.description: The User who manages the Exam.

connection_loss.description: What happens when the server loses its connection to an Attempt.

execution.description: Whether the Attempts get an execution environment, from which profile, and how many terminals.

focus_loss.description: When leaving the Exam window counts against the candidate.

native.description: What Proctor Desktop watches or blocks on the candidate's computer.

ExamRecordsCompletionResponse.description: Records completion state of one Sitting.

completed_at.description: Time of the most recent completion. Omitted before the first.

completed_by_user_id.description: User who made the most recent completion. Omitted before the first.

completed_evidence_revision.description: Evidence revision acknowledged by the most recent completion. 0 before the first completion.

current.description: True when the Sitting's records are completed and no newer evidence has been accepted since. Retention can only start from a current completion.

evidence_revision.description: Revision of the Sitting's accepted integrity evidence. It goes up each time new evidence is accepted. Send it as `acknowledged_evidence_revision` to complete.

revision.description: Revision of the completion state. It goes up with each completion and each newly accepted integrity change. Send it as `expected_revision` to complete.

stale_at.description: Time newly accepted evidence made the most recent completion stale. Omitted while the completion is current, and before the first.

ExamRecordsSnapshotResponse.description: A Sitting's records completion state, with counts that show whether it can be completed.

pending_reviews.description: Number of Submission Reviews still to finalize or waive before the records can be completed.

sitting_state.description: Delivery state of the Sitting. Records can only be completed once it is `closed`.

submission_count.description: Number of Submissions in the Sitting.

ExamResourceUploadMetadata.description: The metadata part of a new Resource upload.

description_markdown.description: An optional description, as Markdown. Up to 16,384 bytes of UTF-8.

display_name.description: The name candidates see, up to 255 characters. Leading and trailing spaces are removed.

expected_revision.description: The Draft revision you last saw. If the Draft has changed since, the upload fails with a conflict.

media_type.description: The media type of the content.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest of the content, as lowercase hex.

size.description: The exact length of the content, in bytes. It must also fit the Draft's Resource size limit.

ExamResourceUploadMultipart.description: Exactly two parts, in this order: metadata as application/json (up to 32,768 bytes), then content.

ExamResponse.description: The authoring view of one Exam. It holds the Exam itself and its current Draft. Published Revisions are returned by the Revision operations instead.

draft.description: The Exam's current Draft. Use its revision for Draft changes and publishing.

exam.description: The Exam record. Use its revision for Exam-level changes such as archiving.

manager_count.description: How many Users currently manage the Exam, including the owner.

owner_user_id.description: The User who currently owns the Exam. This is the same value as exam.owner_user_id.

items.description: The Revisions on this page, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Send this back as cursor to get the next page. Omitted on the last page.

ExamRevisionResponse.description: A summary of one published Revision. A Revision is a copy of the Draft taken at publication, and it can't change.

base_revision_id.description: The Revision this one was based on: the one the Draft was last published as, or the Revision a live correction changes. Omitted for the first Revision.

capacity.description: The Resource and Starter Workspace limits that applied at publication.

content_digest.description: The SHA-256 digest of everything the Revision holds, as lowercase hex: title, instructions, policies, capacity, Resources and Starter Workspace. Two Revisions with the same content have the same digest.

exam_id.description: The Exam this Revision belongs to.

number.description: The Revision's number within the Exam. The first Revision is 1, and each new one adds 1.

policy_digest.description: The SHA-256 digest of the Revision's integrity policy, as lowercase hex. Two Revisions with the same policy have the same digest.

policy_schema_version.description: The version of the policy format the Revision was saved in. Always 2 today.

publication_kind.description: standard means the Revision was published from the Draft. live_correction means it corrects a Revision during a running Sitting.

published_by_user_id.description: The User who published the Revision.

resource_count.description: How many Resources the Revision includes.

source_draft_revision.description: The Draft revision this Revision was published from.

starter_workspace_digest.description: The SHA-256 digest of the Starter Workspace file list and contents, as lowercase hex.

starter_workspace_entry_count.description: How many files and directories the Revision's Starter Workspace has.

starter_workspace_total_bytes.description: The total size of the Starter Workspace files, in bytes.

environments_waiting_capacity.description: How many of the Sitting's execution environments wait for a host with room, across every page.

items.description: Candidate rows, in ascending order of candidate User ID.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omitted on the last page. Send it back unchanged as cursor.

server_time.description: Server time the board was worked out at.

description_markdown.description: A Markdown description shown with the resource, at most 16384 bytes of UTF-8. Can be empty.

display_name.description: The name candidates see, with no leading or trailing whitespace and at most 255 characters.

replaces_resource_id.description: The existing resource whose content you are replacing. Only for `replacement`.

size.description: The file size in bytes, at most 100 MiB. It must match the uploaded content.

target_kind.description: `addition` uploads a new resource. `replacement` uploads new content for an existing resource.

ExamSittingCorrectionResourceStageRespon.description: A staged upload that is ready to use in a correction.

expires_at.description: The time after which the stage can no longer be used in a correction.

resource_id.description: The resource the content belongs to. For an addition this is a new ID; for a replacement it is the `replaces_resource_id` you sent.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest of the uploaded file, as lowercase hex.

size.description: The uploaded file's size in bytes.

closed_at.description: When the Sitting finished closing. Omitted until it is closed.

scheduled_end_at.description: The Sitting's deadline. An extension moves it later.

scheduled_start_at.description: When the Sitting is scheduled to open.

updated_at.description: When the Sitting last changed.

ExamSubmissionManagerResponse.description: A summary of one sealed Submission, without file contents or integrity evidence. When the Institution's retention policy has retired the integrity data, the summary gives the retirement time and leaves out the focus-loss and unresolved counts. The submitted work stays available.

assistant_transcript_digest.description: The digest on the sealed receipt. Omitted after transcript retirement.

exam_id.description: The Exam the Submission belongs to.

exam_revision_id.description: The Exam Revision the Sitting delivered when the Submission was sealed.

exam_sitting_id.description: The Sitting the Submission belongs to.

final_focus_loss_sequence.description: The last focus-loss sequence number accepted when the Attempt was sealed. Present, even when zero, until the integrity data is retired.

manifest_total_file_bytes.description: The total size of all sealed files, in bytes.

unresolved_integrity_count.description: The number of integrity items not yet resolved for review. Present, even when zero, until the integrity data is retired.

workspace_cursor.description: The Workspace change cursor that was sealed. Each accepted Workspace change advances it.

workspace_id.description: The Attempt Workspace that was sealed.

state.description: Always `submitted`.

workspace_cursor.description: The last acknowledged Workspace change cursor, which is what was sealed.

created_by_user_id.description: The manager who created the Review.

discrepancy_count.description: The number of Discrepancies covered at finalization. 0 while the Review is a draft.

evidence_count.description: The number of evidence records covered at finalization. 0 while the Review is a draft.

evidence_inventory_digest.description: A SHA-256 digest, as lowercase hex, of the evidence the Review covered when it was finalized. Present only once the Review is finalized.

finalized_by_user_id.description: The manager who finalized the Review. Present only once it is finalized.

flag_count.description: The number of Flags covered at finalization. 0 while the Review is a draft.

manager_notes.description: Private notes for managers. Can be empty.

released_by_user_id.description: The manager who released the result. Present only once it is released.

student_remarks_markdown.description: The remarks for the candidate, in Markdown, as saved. Can be empty.

academic_unit_id.description: The Academic Unit that owns the Exam.

archived_at.description: When the Exam was archived. Omitted while the Exam is active.

creator_user_id.description: The User who created the Exam.

sitting_count.description: How many Sittings the Exam has in total, whatever the Sitting filters.

revision.description: The Sitting's current revision number.

scheduled_start_at.description: When the Sitting is scheduled to start.

state.description: Where the Sitting is in its lifecycle.

title.description: The title from the Exam's current Draft.

ExternalAuthenticationProviderListRespon.description: One page of the collection in its stable order.

device_id.description: An identifier the client chooses for its device, up to 128 bytes. It is recorded on the new Session.
